title: Use Open Circuit SF with AI agents
description: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client to Open Circuit SF's read-only public MCP server. No account or key.
h1: Use Open Circuit SF with AI agents

intro.text: Open Circuit SF runs a public MCP server that AI agents can use to look up our events and newsletter issues. It is read-only, returns only what the public website already shows, and needs no account or key.

blocks.text: Always use the www address. It speaks MCP's Streamable HTTP transport.

blocks.label: Command
blocks.text: claude mcp add --transport http opencircuitsf https://www.opencircuitsf.com/mcp
Most MCP clients accept an mcpServers entry like this one.

items: list_upcoming_events — List upcoming Open Circuit SF events, soonest first.
search_events — Search Open Circuit SF events by words in the title, description and tags.
get_event — Get one Open Circuit SF event by its id (its slug), from list_upcoming_events or search_events.
list_newsletter_issues — List Open Circuit SF newsletter issues, newest first.
get_newsletter_issue — Get one Open Circuit SF newsletter issue by its id (its slug), from list_newsletter_issues.
get_about — What Open Circuit SF is, and how to join, subscribe or get in touch.

blocks.text: Times are RFC 3339 with an offset in America/Los_Angeles. Every event and newsletter result carries its public url.
Drafts, unpublished events, unsent or withheld newsletter issues, attendees, RSVPs and subscribers. It returns only what the public website already shows.
